plan.content: V-ing / to V / V nguyên mẫu, so sánh hơn – nhất – bằng – kép, viết lại câu so sánh
10 câu Sentence completion + 5 câu viết lại
10 câu + 2 câu viết lại: thì, where/which, câu điều kiện
50 câu trong 90 phút, không xem tài liệu
Nghe 20 câu, mỗi đoạn phát 2 lần
Đọc giải thích từng câu sai, gửi điểm từng Paper cho Claude
10 phrasal verb + 10 cụm giới từ + 10 câu
Chủ đề Công việc: 5 câu (hoặc 4 câu Paper 4 trong đề)
Xem lỗi sai theo chủ điểm + quiz 10 câu

sections.title: Sau động từ này dùng gì?
rows: V-ing
enjoy, mind, avoid, finish, suggest, keep, practise, consider, spend time, look forward to, be used to; SAU GIỚI TỪ (interested in, good at, before, after, without, instead of)
I enjoy reading. / She's good at cooking.
to V
want, decide, hope, plan, agree, refuse, promise, manage, afford, learn, would like; It's + adj + to V; too / enough + to V
She decided to leave. / It's hard to learn a language.
V nguyên mẫu
can, must, should, will…; had better; would rather; let / make + người + V
You'd better go. / My mum made me clean my room.
Cả hai, KHÁC nghĩa
stop, remember, forget, try
stop smoking = bỏ hút; stop to smoke = dừng lại để hút. remember to lock = nhớ phải khóa; remember locking = nhớ là đã khóa.

sections.title: So sánh
headers: Tính từ ngắn (1 âm tiết, hoặc 2 âm tiết tận cùng -y)
rows: Hơn
adj-er + than
more + adj + than
Hanoi is bigger than Hue. / This book is more interesting than that one.
Nhất
the + adj-est
the most + adj
the tallest building / the most beautiful city
Bằng
as + adj + as
as + adj + as
My sister is not as tall as me.
Kép (càng… càng…)
The + adj-er, the + adj-er
The more + adj, the more + adj
The older he gets, the wiser he becomes.
Bất quy tắc
good – better – best; bad – worse – worst; far – further – furthest
many/much – more – most; little – less – least
Her English is better than mine.

sections.title: Viết lại câu so sánh, too / enough, so / such
rows: My house is smaller than yours.
Your house is bigger than mine.
Đổi chủ ngữ → dùng tính từ trái nghĩa.
No one in my class is taller than Nam.
Nam is the tallest student in my class.
No one … -er than → the -est.
He is too young to drive.
He isn't old enough to drive.
too + adj ↔ not + adj TRÁI NGHĨA + enough.
The film was so boring that we left.
It was such a boring film that we left.
so + adj ↔ such + a/an + adj + danh từ.
It takes me an hour to cook.
I spend an hour cooking.
spend + thời gian + V-ing (KHÔNG phải to V). Bạn đã sai mẫu này ở ngày 3.

notes: Sau giới từ luôn là V-ing, kể cả chữ "to" trong look forward to, be used to, get used to: I look forward to seeing you.
Nhấn mạnh so sánh hơn: much / far / a lot + adj-er. Không dùng very: much bigger, không nói very bigger.
Tính từ 2 âm tiết tận cùng -y: happy → happier → the happiest; busy → busier.
Không dùng cả more và -er cùng lúc: wider, không phải more wider.

traps.title: look forward to + V nguyên mẫu
traps.wrong: I look forward to see you.
traps.right: I look forward to seeing you.
traps.why: "to" ở đây là giới từ → sau nó là V-ing.

traps.title: Dùng cả more và -er
traps.wrong: This road is more wider than that one.
traps.right: This road is wider than that one.
traps.why: Tính từ ngắn chỉ thêm -er; tính từ dài mới dùng more.

traps.title: spend + to V
traps.wrong: I spend 30 minutes to get to work.
traps.right: I spend 30 minutes getting to work.
traps.why: spend + thời gian + V-ing. Câu có to V là It takes me 30 minutes to get to work.

grammarMcq.q: I'm thinking about ___ a new car.
They agreed ___ the meeting until Friday.
Please remember ___ the lights before you leave.
grammarMcq.explain: remember to V = nhớ PHẢI làm (việc chưa làm). remember V-ing = nhớ là ĐÃ làm.

grammarMcq.q: He stopped ___ because it was bad for his health.
grammarMcq.explain: stop + V-ing = bỏ hẳn việc đó. stop to smoke = dừng lại để hút, sai nghĩa.

grammarMcq.q: Hue is ___ than Ho Chi Minh City.
grammarMcq.explain: Có than → so sánh hơn. quiet là tính từ ngắn → quieter. Không dùng cả more và -er.

grammarMcq.q: Of all my friends, Mai is the ___ at maths.
grammarMcq.explain: Of all + the → so sánh nhất. good – better – best.

grammarMcq.q: My new phone is ___ more expensive than my old one.
grammarMcq.explain: Nhấn mạnh so sánh hơn: much / far / a lot. Không dùng very.

grammarMcq.q: The older my grandfather gets, the ___ he becomes.
grammarMcq.explain: So sánh kép: The + so sánh hơn, the + so sánh hơn. forgetful dài → more forgetful.

grammarMcq.q: It's not easy ___ a new language.

grammarMcq.explain: interested in + V-ing (giới từ in, sau giới từ là V-ing).

transform.source: It takes me an hour to cook dinner.
answers: I spend an hour cooking dinner.
I spend one hour cooking dinner.
transform.explain: spend + thời gian + V-ing. Không viết to cook (bạn sai mẫu này ở ngày 3).

transform.source: No one in my family is taller than my father.
answers: My father is the tallest in my family.
My father is the tallest person in my family.
My father is the tallest member of my family.
My father is the tallest in the family.
transform.explain: No one … taller than → the tallest.

transform.source: He is too young to get a driving licence.
answers: He isn't old enough to get a driving licence.
He isn't old enough to get a driving license.
transform.explain: too young ↔ not old enough. enough đứng SAU tính từ.

transform.source: I don't have enough money, so I can't buy this laptop.
answers: If I had enough money, I could buy this laptop.
If I had enough money, I would buy this laptop.
If I had enough money, I would be able to buy this laptop.
transform.explain: Hiện tại → loại 2: don't have → had; can't → could. Vế chính PHẢI có could/would (ngày 3 bạn viết thiếu: I drove).

transform.source: It was such a hot day that we stayed at home.
answers: The day was so hot that we stayed at home.
transform.explain: such + a + adj + N ↔ so + adj.

extra.title: Luyện thêm: thì, where / which, câu điều kiện
extra.note: Ngày 3 bạn vẫn chọn have/has khi có mốc quá khứ (last year, when she was a student, khi về nhà), chọn where chỉ vì thấy tên địa danh, và viết sai dạng động từ khi viết lại câu điều kiện. Câu 6 và 7 là một cặp: cùng "the hotel" nhưng một câu where, một câu which. Hãy nhìn PHÍA SAU chỗ trống.

sets.title: Thì + mệnh đề quan hệ + điều kiện

items.q: She ___ in Can Tho when she was a child.
items.explain: when she was a child → giai đoạn đã qua → quá khứ đơn.
since 2018 → have + V3. Người sở hữu nhà (chủ động) → không có been.

items.q: When we reached the cinema, the film ___.
items.explain: Mốc: lúc tới rạp (quá khứ). Phim bắt đầu trước đó → had + V3.

items.q: Phu Quoc, ___ has beautiful beaches, is popular with tourists.
items.explain: Ngay sau là ĐỘNG TỪ (has) → which làm chủ ngữ. Phu Quoc là địa danh nhưng vẫn dùng which.

items.q: The hotel ___ we stayed last summer was very clean.
items.explain: we stayed (ở lại) đã đủ nghĩa, không thiếu tân ngữ → where (= at which).

items.q: The hotel ___ we booked online was very clean.
items.explain: we booked (đặt cái gì?) THIẾU tân ngữ → which. So với câu trên: stayed → where, booked → which.

items.q: If I ___ you, I would talk to her.
items.explain: would + V → loại 2 → If I were. had been là loại 3 (ngày 3 bạn chọn nhầm cái này).

items.q: If he had studied harder, he ___ the exam.
items.explain: had + V3 → loại 3 → would have + V3.

items.q: If I had a car, I ___ you to the airport.
items.explain: Vế if có had (V2) → loại 2 → vế chính PHẢI có could/would + V. drove thiếu would/could.

transform.source: He didn't leave early, so he missed the train.
answers: If he had left early, he wouldn't have missed the train.
If he had left early, he would not have missed the train.
If he had left earlier, he wouldn't have missed the train.
If he had left earlier, he would not have missed the train.
transform.explain: Quá khứ → loại 3. Vế if: had + V3 (had left). Vế chính: wouldn't have + V3 (missed → wouldn't have missed vì đổi sang phủ định).

transform.source: We moved to this flat in 2021.
answers: We have lived in this flat since 2021.
We have been living in this flat since 2021.
transform.explain: moved … in 2021 → have lived … since 2021. Không có been + V3.

vocab.colloc: the plane takes off / take off your shoes
vocab.example: The plane will take off in ten minutes.
She was brought up by her grandparents.

vocab.colloc: put up with the noise / sb's behaviour
vocab.example: I can't put up with the noise any longer.

vocab.colloc: make up a story / an excuse
vocab.example: He made up an excuse for being late.

vocab.meaning: tìm ra cách giải; tập thể dục
vocab.colloc: work out the answer / work out at the gym
vocab.example: I can't work out how to use this app.
Can I try on these jeans?
Hold on, I'll get a pen.

vocab.colloc: go on + V-ing / What's going on?
vocab.example: What's going on in the street?

vocab.colloc: the car / the computer broke down
vocab.example: Our car broke down on the way to Vung Tau.

vocab.colloc: put on a coat / put on weight
vocab.example: Put on your jacket. It's cold.
I'm interested in learning Japanese.
My brother is good at fixing computers.
Are you afraid of flying?
The manager is responsible for training new staff.
Our plan depends on the weather.
He apologised for being late.
My job is very different from my father's.
Hoi An is famous for its old town.

vocab.colloc: proud of my parents / of + V-ing
vocab.example: My parents are proud of me.
She succeeded in passing the exam.

vocabMcq.q: The plane will ___ in ten minutes. Please fasten your seat belts.
vocabMcq.explain: take off = cất cánh. take after = giống; take up = bắt đầu (sở thích).

vocabMcq.q: Excuse me, can I ___ these jeans?
vocabMcq.explain: try on = mặc thử (quần áo). try out = thử (máy móc, phương pháp).

vocabMcq.q: I can't ___ the noise from my neighbours any longer.
vocabMcq.explain: put up with = chịu đựng. put on = mặc vào; put away = cất đi.

vocabMcq.q: Hanoi is famous ___ its street food.
She was brought ___ by her grandparents in the countryside.
vocabMcq.explain: bring up = nuôi dạy (bị động: was brought up).

vocabMcq.q: Whether we go or not depends ___ the weather.
He ___ an excuse for being late, but nobody believed him.
vocabMcq.explain: make up an excuse = bịa ra lý do.

vocabMcq.q: My brother is very good ___ fixing computers.
The manager is responsible ___ training new staff.
vocabMcq.explain: responsible for + V-ing = chịu trách nhiệm.

speaking.introTitle: Bài mẫu: Your job (khoảng 1 phút, điền chỗ trống)
intro: I work as a/an ___ at ___. I have worked there for ___ years.
What I enjoy most is ___ (V-ing) because ___.
However, the most difficult part is ___ (V-ing).
Compared to my first job, this job is ___-er / more ___.
In the future, I hope to ___ after I finish my master's degree.
speaking.frame: Ý chính → Lý do (because…) → Ví dụ (For example…)
rescue: That's an interesting question. Let me think…
Could you repeat the question, please?
I'm not sure, but I think…

questions.hint: I work as a… at… I have worked there for… (chủ động → không có been). Nếu đang đi học: I'm a student at…

questions.q: What do you like most about your job?
questions.hint: What I like most is + V-ing / N. → because… → For example…

questions.q: What is the most difficult part of your job?
questions.hint: The most difficult thing is + V-ing… Dùng so sánh nhất.

questions.q: Is your job more interesting than your studies at university? Why?
questions.hint: So sánh hơn: It's more interesting / busier / less stressful than… Có lý do + ví dụ.

questions.q: Would you like to change your job in the future?
questions.hint: I'd like to… / I'm planning to… / If I had the chance, I would… (loại 2: had → would).

rubric: Trôi chảy (ít ngập ngừng, nói đủ ý)
Ngữ pháp (thì đúng, V-ing / to V, so sánh)
Từ vựng (đúng chủ đề công việc, có cụm giới từ)
Nội dung (trả lời đúng câu hỏi, có lý do và ví dụ)

reviewQuiz.q: I avoid ___ coffee in the evening.
This exercise is ___ than the last one.
If it ___ sunny tomorrow, we will go hiking.
reviewQuiz.explain: will → loại 1 → vế if: hiện tại đơn.

reviewQuiz.q: The village ___ my mother was born is very small.
reviewQuiz.explain: my mother was born đã đủ nghĩa → where.

reviewQuiz.q: I wish I ___ to your party last week.
reviewQuiz.explain: last week → tiếc về quá khứ → wish + had + V3.

reviewQuiz.q: He ___ in the army for two years when he was young.
reviewQuiz.explain: when he was young → quá khứ đơn.

reviewQuiz.q: She spent the whole weekend ___ for the exam.
___ the bad weather, the plane landed safely.
reviewQuiz.explain: Sau là danh từ, nghĩa tương phản → Despite.
Vật + yet → bị động hiện tại hoàn thành.
